result_preview.title: Vendor Invoice Reconciliation Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously matches vendor invoices to POs and contracts, flags discrepancies for approval.
result_preview.description: This agent automatically reconciles incoming vendor invoices against purchase orders and master contracts using three-way matching logic. It validates line-item quantities, pricing, and terms; flags exceptions such as overbilling, duplicate invoices, or policy violations; and routes approved invoices for payment processing. This reduces manual touchpoints, accelerates cash flow, and minimizes payment disputes.

result_preview.title: Procurement Matching Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously matches purchase requisitions to optimal vendors based on cost, quality, and delivery performance.
result_preview.description: This agent analyzes open purchase requisitions against vendor master data, historical performance metrics, and material specifications to automatically recommend and create purchase orders. It evaluates vendor pricing, lead times, quality ratings, and contract terms to optimize procurement decisions, reducing manual effort and ensuring compliance with preferred vendor agreements.

result_preview.title: Quality Assurance and Defect Prevention Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Monitors production quality, automates defect detection, and coordinates corrective actions across machines and orders.
result_preview.description: Continuously monitors machines and production orders to identify quality anomalies and coordinates real-time defect detection across the production floor. Automates quality inspection workflows by analyzing measurement data, triggering automated holds on non-conforming batches, and initiating corrective actions to prevent downstream quality issues. Processes quality inspection records to optimize production parameters and reduces scrap by coordinating machine recalibration and material rework decisions.

result_preview.title: Safety Procurement Invoice Validator
result_preview.shortDescription: Verifies incoming supplier invoices against contractual commitments and purchase documentation, identifying anomalies for compliance review.
result_preview.description: Systematically validates supplier invoices by cross-referencing purchase orders and contractual terms using multi-point verification. Detects irregularities including billing overages, repeated submissions, and non-compliance issues; escalates flagged items to authorized personnel for determination. Streamlines payment authorization workflows, enhances vendor accountability, and mitigates procurement risk.
